verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs say it records token usage for every request and lets you track cost in real time. Loop, its AI agent, can build dashboards, so the core cost-monitoring capability is first-party. However, the evidence never shows cost or token dashboards broken down by model or by time period. missing for 10: documented cost/token dashboards with per-model and per-time-period breakdowns, explicit per-request cost (not just tokens) display, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: recording inputs, outputs, model parameters, latency, token usage, and metadata for every request
